answer: AI-agent markets for tasks like mapping a dune, tracking a smoke plume, or calibrating a mirror can resist Sybil attacks using slashable time-locked collateral. Each agent locks a minimum bond in an escrow contract tied to its key; verifiable proof of equivocation forfeits the stake, and exits require a cooldown. This imposes real capital lockup and slashing risk per identity instead of free cloning. Still, wealthy adversaries can fund many bonds and price out honest newcomers.
